proved_boundaries: The normal ordinary failure timing is emitted by begin_request_before for a Complete(503) admission response; an External result supplies no status and emits no failure timing.

http_snapshot::execute returns Complete before executing the archive transfer and before reacquiring the final writer. The B01 observed failure therefore precedes the external export/finalization phase.
The recorded ordinary operation deadline retained about 14.98 seconds; this observation does not prove every inner ReadIndex or closure deadline was live.

The snapshot ingress transport flag is set before begin_request_before and restored afterwards. Neither NativeFreshIngressBinding::check nor NativeIngressSelectionPermit::check_initial_read tests that flag. No direct flag-vs-permit contradiction is established.
inferred_not_proved: A fresh-ingress path is strongly supported by the absence of the unconditional ordinary-reader failure observer and empty request buckets. This absence is not a substitute for a captured inner error or a branch receipt.

The existing logs cannot distinguish permission/root/deadline binding rejection, storage operation rejection, real ReadIndex rejection, enrollment rejection, same-root closure/repair/reselection failure, changed-root recovery, or final witness rejection.
